annotation.bound_parties_text: The AC applies to a person intending to conduct BVLOS operations using a UA in Singapore, i.e. operators (and UA pilots) applying for permits.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This AC is applicable for a person intending to conduct BVLOS operations using a UA in Singapore.
annotation.dates_quote: This AC is effective from 2 January 2020.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This Advisory Circular provides an overview of CAAS’ assessment methodology for Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) operations for Unmanned Aircraft (UA) in Singapore.
